questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes OpenID Connect (OIDC)?
options: OIDC can exchange a GitHub-issued identity token for short-lived cloud credentials; the cloud trust policy must validate appropriate audience and subject claims.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
questions.answer_key: OIDC can exchange a GitHub-issued identity token for short-lived cloud credentials; the cloud trust policy must validate appropriate audience and subject claims.
questions.explanation: This is the central behavior of openid connect (oidc): OIDC can exchange a GitHub-issued identity token for short-lived cloud credentials; the cloud trust policy must validate appropriate audience and subject claims. Validate configuration and behavior against the current official reference before production use.
